primary_selection: Highest mean UMA fixed_q20_LOW_request_yield across the three distinct fit seeds, requiring each seed and all three compositions to be evaluated. This is a DEVELOPMENT selection from many arms, not a significance test.
ties: If exact equal mean yield, choose highest balanced macro yield; then prefer radial, histogram, smooth, directional, redundant controls, then lower latent dimension.
iteration_design: At each of two rounds compare CVAE- and fixed-bank mutation-acquired labels at common composition and attempted/actual query budgets (Q=16 vs Q=128 unique per count, 256 attempts per count); compare matched warm-start control with no new data; original H0 weights and schema fixed; reset optimizer/clock for every arm. Additional target-weight sensitivity may be evaluated as a separately identified intervention. Use 3 fit seeds and fresh protected assessment proposal streams.
caveats: Sampling streams for CVAE and mutation are matched in count and proposal budget only; unparented CVAE outputs do not share seed masks or edit budget. Fixed-bank mutation shares literal seed/k/edit streams across the mutation controls and rounds use distinct namespaces.
technical_eligibility: A representation must pass independently reviewed GPU descriptor causality/symmetry and checkpoint checks, or a documented targeted control must explain and bound a numerical discrepancy; exclude unresolved failures before ranking.
